claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing
claims.evidence: The photos show pallets but cannot prove this general commercial claim, and it is not specific to the condition of this item.

risks.risk: Exact dimensions (length, width, height) are unknown
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure or ruler alongside the pallet
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown or non-standard size

risks.risk: Load capacity or weight rating is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of any certification stamps, brand marks, or load-rating labels

risks.risk: Wood species or treatment type is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of wood grain, end grain, and treatment stamps such as HT or MB

risks.risk: Total quantity available for sale is unclear; photos show one indoor pallet and an outdoor stack but not what is included
risks.proof: Wide shot showing every pallet included in the sale

risks.risk: Hidden structural damage, rot, or broken boards beyond visible wear
risks.proof: Close-up photos or clip of the underside, stringers, and all board edges

proof_requests: Close-up of pallet stamps or certification marks
Photo with tape measure showing length, width, and height
Wide shot of all pallets for sale to confirm quantity
Close-up of underside and board condition to check for rot or breaks
response.reason: The witness identifies a wooden pallet, so it can be priced at its worst case; missing details on size, capacity, treatment, quantity, and hidden condition are conservatively priced and can be raised with proof.
